## Details

<a id="fireball_shape_mask"></a>
### [`fireball_shape_mask`](../../../../src/graphics/fireball_shape.asm#L8) `$4322-$4325`

*data*

Fireball shape: 4 row masks. update_fireballs ANDs a random byte with mask[x] (x = 3..0) and stores it in the first byte of sprite rows 0-3 of both fireball sprites (sprite_buf_b_spr2 and sprite_buf_b_spr3, every third byte), so on each pass the ball flickers inside the outline $18,$3C,$3C,$18.

- **Read by:** [`update_fireballs`](../room/wizard_fireballs.md#update_fireballs)
